name: 16881-imagechat-qwen25vl3b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one vLLM engine, served in-process through guidellm's vllm_python backend.
architecture: Qwen2_5_VLForConditionalGeneration, bf16, 3.75B params, ~7.1 GB of weights; native-resolution ViT, so a 512x512 image is 324 merged vision tokens on this checkpoint's 28-pixel grid.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams = 128, equal to `--max-num-seqs` so client concurrency and engine admission are the same number. Warmup 25%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 4096 requests with a 2400 s safety cap, static seed 16881.
workload: single-turn image chat, synthesised at run time: 200 text tokens plus one 512x512 jpeg (gradient content, quality 85) in, 200 tokens out, both distributions pinned min == max. The image is 324 vision tokens on this checkpoint and ~14.6 KiB on the wire, and every row's image is distinct.
purpose: A single-image chat assistant on a 3B vision model, serving 128 concurrent short prompts on one GPU.
launch:
model: Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct

disable-log-requests: true

max-num-seqs: 128

block-size: 16

max-num-batched-tokens: 8192

max-model-len: 8192

# Prefix caching defaults ON in this era, so this line is doing work.
enable-prefix-caching: false

tensor-parallel-size: 1
